summary.text: Savet Constantine represents Connecticut's 42nd House District, which includes Wilton and parts of New Canaan and Ridgefield, and is Vice Chair of the Finance, Revenue and Bonding Committee.

paragraphs.text: She was raised in Minnesota and earned a B.A. from Carleton College and a Master of International Affairs from Columbia University.
Constantine has lived in Wilton since 2004 and was president of the Wilton High School PTSA from 2016 to 2019 and of the Middlebrook PTA from 2013 to 2015.
